I need to respond to a trade regarding Vermont. The offer from Gemini is $150, but we bought Vermont for $90. This makes Vermont more valuable to us, possibly worth $200 or more as a strategic denial. Selling it could give them a near-complete blue set, which is concerning.**Formulating a counter offer**

I definitely don’t want to give Gemini a near-complete light blue set for just a modest premium.
